definitions: Fictional amorphous, protoplasmic beings of varying size, capable of forming pseudopods and other organs at will, often depicted as intelligent but malevolent.
In the Cthulhu Mythos, a servitor race created by the Elder Things.
examples: The explorers encountered ancient ruins said to be guarded by shoggoths.
Whispers of the shoggoths' return spread through the forbidden texts.
Their formless bodies allowed the shoggoths to squeeze through impossibly small openings.
